messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — Acme's security questionnaire hit my inbox. Q1: 'Are logs encrypted at rest and who can access raw logs?' Need a short firm answer. Any objections to saying 'KMS-encrypted at rest, access via IAM, subprocessors limited to masked logs'?
Tim Park: Yep — logs stored in ELK/CloudStorage are encrypted with our KMS key (redwood-logs-prod). Access is gated by IAM roles; only logging-admin and infra-oncall can read raw logs. Ingestion account for LogStream Inc only has write/ingest permissions, not raw-read.
Anya Sokolov: Small caveat — we run a redaction step before ingest (PII redaction lambda). Most app logs are masked. Exception: support-traces bucket contains unredacted traces retained for 30d for debugging; access to that bucket requires an approved ticket + approver sign-off.
Maria Chen: Good call. Acme will want to know about exceptions. Can we phrase it like: 'PII is redacted by default; limited support traces retained for 30 days with gated access'?
Tim Park: Yes. A couple extra details to include: KMS key management is Redwood-managed in prod, with rotation policies and audit logs captured in Cloud Audit. We rotate keys on an annual schedule. Also, we produce key-use logs for audit.
Samir Patel: On subprocessors: our logging vendor (LogStream Inc) only receives masked logs under the DPA. Legal has a signed DPA and security questionnaire responses on file. I'll attach the DPA to the CS ticket.
Anya Sokolov: If Acme asks for SOC2/ISO evidence: point them to the compliance portal and attach the redaction/dataflow diagram. I can export the diagram and a short blurb about the redaction pipeline.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Can someone DM me the exact IAM role names + KMS key path so I can include them in the response? Also flagging this for CS to follow up.
sec-bot: Reminder: for requests involving subprocessors/DPAs open a CS ticket and attach DPA artifacts. Template: `/cs create "dpa-request"`
Tim Park: IAM roles: `logging-admin`, `infra-oncall`, `support-trace-access`. KMS key path: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/logging/cryptoKeys/redwood-logs-key`. Redaction regex example we use upstream: `s/(?i)(\b(creditcard|ssn|email):\s*[^,\s]+)/REDACTED/g`
Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll draft the response and send to Acme, looping in Legal/CS. /cc @Anya Sokolov @Samir Patel
